subheadline: Four steps from the first prototype to 244 content elements for TYPO3 v14.

milestones.title: Ten content element groups
milestones.description: Hero, Features, Pricing and seven more groups gave editors a full set of parts for building pages.

milestones.title: A strict template audit
milestones.description: An automated template audit joined CI: no inline styles, no fixed colours, no exceptions.

milestones.title: Five icon libraries
milestones.description: You can switch between Lucide, Tabler, HugeIcons, Phosphor and Remix. Elements use fixed icon names, so every library fits.

milestones.title: 244 elements, one command
milestones.description: One command, desiderio:styleguide:seed, now builds the whole styleguide. It is safe in workspaces and can run again without duplicates.
